nodes.description: Foundation Phase (Grades R-3)

nodes.title: Grade 1
nodes.description: Grade 1

nodes.title: Life Skills
nodes.description: Life Skills for Grade 1 — Foundation Phase CAPS. Study areas: Beginning Knowledge (BK), Personal and Social Well-being (PSW), Creative Arts, Physical Education (PE)

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Grade 1 Life Skills Term 1

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Orientation and Perceptual Development
nodes.description: Orientation to school environment; classroom routines; school rules; perceptual development activities

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: Orientation

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Me
nodes.description: Learner's identity: name, age, gender, home language; family members; personal information; uniqueness; parts of the body

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: Me

nodes.title: PSW & BK: At School
nodes.description: People and places at school; classroom objects and their uses; school rules and responsibilities; getting along with others

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: At School

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Healthy Habits
nodes.description: Personal hygiene: washing hands, brushing teeth; eating habits; importance of exercise and rest; healthy food choices

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: Healthy Habits

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Weather
nodes.description: Seasons and weather: observe and describe daily weather; appropriate clothing for different weather conditions; weather effects on daily life

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: Weather

nodes.title: Creative Arts — Visual Arts
nodes.description: Explore and experiment with a variety of media and materials; drawing, painting, collage; respond to artwork

nodes.title: Creative Arts — Performing Arts
nodes.description: Drama: role play, mime, movement; Music: songs, rhymes, rhythmic activities; Dance: movement to music, basic actions

nodes.title: Physical Education
nodes.description: Body management and movement skills; balancing, jumping, skipping; ball skills; simple games; locomotor and non-locomotor skills

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Grade 1 Life Skills Term 2

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Family
nodes.description: My family: members and roles; different types of families; family relationships; responsibilities within the family; family history

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: Family

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Safety in the Home
nodes.description: Identifying safe and unsafe situations at home; safe use of household items; fire safety; what to do in an emergency; road safety basics

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: Safety in the Home

nodes.title: PSW & BK: My Body and My Senses
nodes.description: The five senses and their body parts; what each sense does; how we use our senses to learn about the world

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: My Body and My Senses

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Keeping My Body Safe
nodes.description: Private body parts; appropriate and inappropriate touch; saying no to unwanted touching; trusted adults; personal safety rules

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: Keeping My Body Safe

nodes.title: Creative Arts — Visual Arts
nodes.description: Drawing and painting with different media; collage related to themes; printmaking; construction with recycled materials

nodes.title: Creative Arts — Performing Arts
nodes.description: Mime and dramatic play; songs and rhymes related to themes; rhythmic and expressive movement

nodes.title: Physical Education
nodes.description: Locomotor skills: running, hopping, galloping; body coordination; manipulative skills with balls; simple team games; movement to music

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Grade 1 Life Skills Term 3 (content based on CAPS curriculum scope)

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Food and Nutrition
nodes.description: Healthy food choices; food groups; where food comes from; importance of eating a balanced diet; hunger and food insecurity

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: Food and Nutrition

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Feelings and Emotions
nodes.description: Identifying and naming feelings; expressing emotions appropriately; managing feelings; empathy; dealing with conflict

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being: Feelings and Emotions

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Plants
nodes.description: Parts of plants; what plants need to grow; life cycle of a plant; plants we eat; caring for plants

nodes.title: Creative Arts
nodes.description: Visual arts: drawing, collage, painting linked to themes; Performing Arts: drama, music, movement and dance activities

nodes.title: Physical Education
nodes.description: Rhythmic activities; body coordination and balance; manipulative skills; ball games; movement games and simple sports

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Grade 1 Life Skills Term 4 (content based on CAPS curriculum scope)

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Animals
nodes.description: Domestic and wild animals; characteristics and habitats; what animals need to survive; animals and their young; caring for animals

nodes.title: PSW & BK: My Community
nodes.description: People in the community and their roles; community helpers; local environment; caring for the environment; responsibilities as a community member

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being / Beginning Knowledge: My Community

nodes.title: PSW & BK: Rights and Responsibilities
nodes.description: Children's rights; responsibilities at home and school; being a good citizen; taking care of shared spaces; rules in society

metadata.capsReference: Personal and Social Well-being: Rights and Responsibilities

nodes.title: Creative Arts
nodes.description: Visual arts: drawing, painting, construction; Performing Arts: songs, drama, movement and dance; end-of-year celebration activities

nodes.title: Physical Education
nodes.description: Consolidation of locomotor, non-locomotor and manipulative skills; simple team sports; athletic activities; movement and rhythm games
